557358.name: Vrútky
557358.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the town's current website (vrutky.sk) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on, and the Internet Archive's sparse captures of the old site (2016-2021, textsvk/ and download/ files) hold only 2018 election results, no okrsky notice.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: No 2019 EP document found live or archived. The only okrsky documents on ivankaprinitre.sk are of 2022-11 (referendum 2023), 2023-06 (NR SR 2023), 2024-01 (president 2024), 2024-03 (EP 2024), giving only the three polling stations (all in the Kultúrny dom), and 2026-07 (municipal/regional 2026-10-24, with streets). Internet Archive was reachable.

559784.name: Turňa nad Bodvou
559784.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on the website's notice board (which keeps the 2022, 2022-11 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 decisions) or in the Internet Archive: the archived 2018–2020 election pages list only voter information and candidate lists (their 2018 'oznam' PDFs are 404 and not archived), and no decision for 2017, 2019, 2023-09, 2024-06 or the 2026 referendum is published.

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry
560103.note: The town's notice board keeps only current items (the October 2026 elections and the July 2026 referendum's minutes, no okrsky announcement); earlier announcements were removed and survive only in the Internet Archive, which was offline (the 2022 documents in this repository come from it). The host rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so fetching was kept minimal.

560154.name: Smižany
560154.note: No okrsky document of the EP election 2019 (no page) on the website; Internet Archive offline; the host rate-limits requests.

580317.name: Utekáč
580317.note: The elections page links only 'Oznamenie_okrsky.pdf', which states that the obec has 2 okrsky and gives each only its polling station (č. 1 Utekáč 848 sála MKS; č. 2 Utekáč – Drahová 1051), no streets or parts. The register has a single part (Utekáč), so the okrsky cannot be assigned by part; no document defines which addresses vote where. The Internet Archive (offline at first, reachable later) holds for obecutekac.sk in 2017 only captures of older election pages (NR SR 2016, municipal 2014) and no okrsky document.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The website's elections page lists only the 2026 referendum article, whose files (results, information for voters, decision on the referendum) include no okrsky document; older votes are not on the current site. The site then refused our connections (blocked) and the Internet Archive refused connections too, so the notice board and older captures could not be checked; the maintainer may retry.

580899.name: Lužianky
580899.note: For the European Parliament election of 2019 the obec's site keeps only the address for delegating commission members (6.3.2019), the address for voter's certificate requests (10.4.2019) and the results (27.5.2019); no okrsky document. The Internet Archive's first captures of the election pages are of July 2019 (after the vote) and list no okrsky document.

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: The archived page for the European Parliament election of 2019 (volby-do-europskeho-parlamentu.html) lists only the voter information; no okrsky document was found live or in the Internet Archive; the municipality has one part and its later decisions (2022-2026) only name one polling station, Kultúrny dom, Farská 37, for every okrsok, without streets.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The notice board (current and archive) and the site search find okrsky documents only for the 2022 elections and the 2023 referendum; no okrsky document of the European Parliament election of 2019 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

582093.name: Vyšný Medzev
582093.note: No okrsky document for the 2019 European Parliament election is on the website or in the Internet Archive; the archived page and files are only voter information.

582816.name: Žitavany
582816.note: The live website (www.zitavany.sk, Voľby - Referendum) keeps vote pages only from the 2022 elections on; the oldest okrsky document there is the referendum's of 2023. In the Internet Archive (CDX of zitavany.sk 2017–2022 and of the old notice board) no okrsky document of 2017–2020 is captured: the 'Voľby VÚC 2017' page is captured empty (2018-12-30, 2021-05-06); the 2018 notice-board entry 'Voľby do orgánov samosprávy obcí 2018' links only the voters' information and the decision calling the elections; the 2018 obvody notice concerns council obvody only; the 2019 notice board lists EP 2019 voter-information and voting-certificate entries, never captured, and no okrsky entry; the 2020 by-election page links only the obvody/seats decision and results. Web search found nothing else. The Archive was intermittently offline but answered after retries.

598186.name: Košice-Staré Mesto
598186.note: The district's elections page and site search hold documents from 2024 on only (presidential and EP elections 2024, referendum and elections 2026); nothing of this vote. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

598682.name: Košice-Dargovských hrdinov
598682.note: No okrsky document of the EP election 2019 on the website; Internet Archive offline.

599093.name: Košice-Barca
599093.note: The old site's page 'Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2019' (archived 2019-08-21) links 'Určenie volebných okrskov' (/images/subory/ine/Urenie volebnch okrskov OKK.pdf), but the PDF was never captured (404) and is gone from the live site.

599794.name: Košice-Krásna
599794.note: The website's elections page starts with the 2022 elections and the old notice board (to 8/2021) holds nothing on elections; no okrsky document of the European Parliament election of 2019 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

599816.name: Košice-Nad jazerom
599816.note: No okrsky or obvody document of this vote on jazerokosice.sk: the Internet Archive (CDX of the whole domain 2017-2025) holds okrsky lists only for 2019 (presidential), 2022, the 2023 referendum, 2023, and 2024; the live site (rebuilt 2025) and CUET have none.

599824.name: Košice-Juh
599824.note: The district's elections page linked an okrsky document for several votes (e.g. download/33319 for the referendum 2023, download/35781 for the NR SR election 2023, download/37199 for 2024), but the website has deleted them ("Download does not exist") and the Internet Archive kept none of them; for 2017–2020 the archived elections pages link no okrsky document. Only the 2026 documents remain online.

599883.name: Košice-Sídlisko KVP
599883.note: The old website's page for the EP election of 2019 ('Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností', archived) links the mayor's PDF, but the PDF is gone live (404), was not captured by the Internet Archive, and the page itself has no text of the okrsky. The website's archive (archiv.mckvp.sk) answers 503.

599972.name: Košice-Luník IX
599972.note: The live website www.mclunik9.sk refused connections on 2026-10-31. In the Internet Archive, the old site's notice board (uradna_elektronicka_tabula, captured 2019-07-16, listing every item from 2015 to 26.3.2019) and the WordPress board that replaced it in 2020 (oznamenia, captured 2020-10-28; elections page dokumenty/volby empty) list no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' for any vote before 2022: for the European Parliament election of 2019 they post only the e-mail addresses for delegating OVK members and for voting-pass requests (26.3.2019). The archive's list of the domain's PDFs has no okrsky document before the 2022 one (Utvorenie-volebnych-okrskov-a-urcenie-volebnej-miestnosti-v-MC-KE-LIX.pdf, dated 3.8.2022), which may not be used for this vote.
